verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution feature gives AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them, directly inside the product. It runs on OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, auto-prompts the LLM with stack trace, environment and code context, and offers a collaborative in-app chat that can be linked back into error comments. This delivers the core of the story for crash data. Missing for 10: AI insights beyond per-error resolution (e.g. across performance/RUM data or trend summaries), independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on whether a user-supplied OpenAI key is required.
